source_policy.fallback_rule: GitHub/yfinance, FinMind and TAIFEX may fill null fields only when the observation belongs to the same specified trade date/session date. Never silently overwrite a non-null canonical value or use a different trade date.
source_policy.trade_date_rule: U.S. cash-market observations use the latest completed session, Tuesday 2026-08-25. TAIFEX after-hours beginning 2026-08-25 15:00 is attributed to 2026-08-26. If official 2026-08-26 night-session values are not yet retrievable, leave them null for same-session GitHub validation.
source_policy.uncertainty_rule: When authoritative sources disagree, retain the selected canonical source and record cross-check requirements; do not silently blend or overwrite values.

breaking_news.headline: Oil falls more than 3%, bond yields ease and U.S. equities rebound
breaking_news.summary: WTI fell to about $82.42 and the U.S. 10-year yield declined to 4.649%, easing inflation/valuation pressure and helping technology shares recover.
breaking_news.market_impact: Rate-sensitive growth and semiconductors rebounded; the move remains event-sensitive ahead of PCE and Nvidia.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Constructive for Taiwan tech valuation, but Nvidia earnings risk dominates the next session.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. new-home sales drop 10.5%; consumer confidence slips to 89.4
breaking_news.summary: Housing and confidence data softened, reinforcing evidence of slower demand even as inflation concerns remain.
breaking_news.market_impact: Helped push Treasury yields lower; supports duration assets but raises growth questions.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Lower yields support high-multiple electronics; weaker U.S. consumption is a counterweight for consumer hardware.

breaking_news.headline: Dick's cuts annual outlook as footwear demand weakens
breaking_news.summary: Dick's Sporting Goods cut annual sales and adjusted EPS guidance after a weak Foot Locker performance and soft sneaker demand.
breaking_news.market_impact: Highlights discretionary-consumer softness and inventory/promotion pressure.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Watch footwear/textile supply-chain demand signals and U.S. discretionary exposure.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Nvidia earnings becomes the key AI growth test
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Analysts expect roughly $92.18B quarterly revenue and are focused on Rubin ramp, data-center growth, margins and the sustainability of AI financing.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: The report can reset semiconductor and hyperscaler-capex expectations.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Highest sensitivity: TSMC, CoWoS/advanced packaging, AI servers, networking, PCB, cooling and power.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Raymond James upgrades AMD to Strong Buy on agentic-AI server CPU demand
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: AMD rose about 4.9% after Raymond James upgraded the stock and raised its price target to $641, citing server CPU demand tied to AI workloads.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Broadens AI leadership beyond GPUs toward CPUs and data-center compute.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Positive read-through for foundry, server motherboard, ODM and power/cooling supply chains.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Mega-cap AI remains firm but catalyst focus shifts to Nvidia and PCE
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Microsoft rose while Apple was slightly lower; market attention is concentrated on AI capex validation rather than a new company-specific catalyst in the last 24 hours.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Keeps hyperscaler capex and AI monetization in focus.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Microsoft cloud capex remains relevant for AI server demand; Apple moves matter more for consumer electronics supply chain.

narration_points: 美股週二反彈，油價與長債殖利率同步回落，科技與半導體修復，但市場仍在等待NVIDIA財報與PCE。
SOX官方收盤上漲1.20%，NVIDIA上漲2.19%，AMD因券商升評大漲約4.9%，AI硬體風險偏好回升。
WTI跌逾3%至約82.42美元、10年期殖利率降至4.649%，短線降低高估值科技的折現率壓力。
Intuit財測低於預期、Dick's下修全年展望，顯示軟體與消費端仍有分化。
台股盤前優先看美股RRG與台股Rotation是否同步確認AI/半導體、伺服器、網通與散熱；不得只因美股單日反彈追價。
